items.english: "Why are you so quiet?" The man looked at the woman's face in sudden puzzlement and spoke to her. In haste she tried to say something, but unable to get anything out at once she fell silent, and again her eyes ran far away. And she saw the phantom picture again. Then for the first time she quietly heard the sound of the storm outside the door. She said nothing.
notes: 幻の絵 kept as phantom picture to hold it apart from the far picture of p18, as in the Japanese.

items.english: Yes. There is that day. There is the day when all things turn to nostalgia and forgiveness, and peace. After a long life, and after long sorrow, and after long suffering, on the day after them, that peaceful day of nostalgia and forgiveness is there. What are the suffering and sorrow of each day? What are the weariness and trouble of each day? Without knowing when, she had a smile on her face.
notes: なんだらう rendered as plain questions; kept long three times and nostalgia and forgiveness and peace word-for-word for the incantation.

items.english: "Why are you so quiet?" the man said again. She lifted her head as if startled and, smiling with nostalgia, said as if asking him to remember too, to remember all kinds of things, even the happy things from before their marriage, "It has really been only such a little while since we married, hasn't it."
notes: p21-p23 are one sentence in the Japanese, broken for quotation; grouped in English so the tag in p23 has its speech.

items.english: "That's right," he said too, looking up.
"It's only three years. But we have been through a lot."

"Really," she said, and lowered her eyes again to try to see that picture. But at once, "It has still been only three years," she said, her eyes shining as if she must tell him of something large, something large she herself did not understand.
notes: p26-p27 are one movement in the Japanese, ending in すぐに、; grouped in English. Hope left unnamed and untethered, not glossed as the vision.

data.say: Drafted p19 to p27 keeping repetitions plain and grouping split dialogue.
